about: Every image on the Club X reels and its source. Chemical X's works are loaded from the chain as he made them and never redrawn. The X marks, the Mask, the Midnight door, the wristband and the tag are original art drawn in code for this machine (the agreed exception for his signature subject); nothing is copied from his works.

brand.source: https://thisisnumberone.com/wp-content/themes/thisisnumberone/files/images/thisisnumberone/1-colour.svg, read from the live site on 2 Nov 2026 (2,084 bytes, saved byte for byte as art/brand/this-is-number-one-logo.svg, never redrawn). Used on the jackpot symbol tile.
brand.permission: This Is Number One's own logo: needs the platform's OK for use on a public machine

needsPermission: Chemical X's works (BrandX, XLove, and the Genesis piece): shown exactly as he made them on a public machine; needs Chemical X's OK.
The This Is Number One name and logo (taken from thisisnumberone.com), and its Genesis Collection piece: need the platform's and Chemical X's OK.
Any Chemical X PFP or self-portrait for the wild: only as supplied by Jim with Chemical X's OK (none supplied yet).
No other project's logo is used. The Ministry of Sound logo (which Chemical X is credited with) is NOT used or imitated.
notDrawn: No pills or drug imagery are drawn by this machine.

officialArt.about: Official Chemical X images supplied by Jim on 2 Nov 2026 as one 4x4 contact sheet (1254px). Cut into 16 tiles, 6px inset to drop the sheet's gutters, scaled to 320px. Titles are working descriptions only: Jim / Chemical X to supply the real titles. Not on-chain tokens: they carry no contract, token id or Xtrata id, so they never take part in the Forever Twins cameo.
officialArt.source: Supplied by Jim (jimdotbtc), described as official Chemical X images
officialArt.note: Supplied by Jim as official Chemical X images. Several pieces are pill mosaics and one is a bottle silhouette; Club X's own drawn art has no pills or drug imagery. Four are character portraits (CX hoodie), a candidate for the Wild.
